name: Aquidneck Island Day Camp
description_short: A summer day camp in Middletown, RI. It runs field trips through the summer, and campers choose from on-site activities. It mainly serves families from Newport, Middletown, Portsmouth, Tiverton, Little Compton, Bristol and Warren.
